scripts.engine:dev: cd services/engine && uv run uvicorn engine.api:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.engine:check: cd services/engine && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy engine tests && uv run pytest
scripts.engine:eval: cd services/engine && uv run python -m engine.evaluation
scripts.plan:gen: pnpm --filter @kartplan/shared gen:plan-schema && cd services/engine && uv run python scripts/gen_plan_models.py
